title: Refund Amount of a Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment Return
content:
# Refund Amount of a Self-Pay PAP Therapy Equipment Return

**Clause.** The refund of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment device starts from the device price charged on the sale line being refunded, less a restocking fee of the class's restocking percentage of that price, rounded half up to the cent, and less the standard accessory kit of **104.00 USD** for the used mask and tubing. The refund does not include the delivery fee. The refund is stated in USD, rounded half up to the cent.

**The quantities.**

| Quantity | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| device price | the price charged on the sale line being refunded, in the device's billing history |
| restocking percentage | the self-pay restocking percentage of the device class |
| restocking fee | the price multiplied by that percentage and divided by 100, rounded half up to the cent |
| accessory kit | 104.00, for the used mask and tubing |
| delivery fee | not part of the refund |

**Refund** — the device price, less the restocking fee, less the accessory kit.

## Worked refunds (hypothetical sale lines at list price)

- Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601), price 899.00, restocking percentage 15: the fee is 134.85; the refund is 899.00 less 134.85 less 104.00, or 660.15.
- Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470), price 1850.00, percentage 15: fee 277.50; refund 1850.00 less 277.50 less 104.00, or 1468.50.
- Bilevel PAP Spontaneous-Timed System (E0471), price 4200.00, percentage 20: fee 840.00; refund 4200.00 less 840.00 less 104.00, or 3256.00.

**Points of judgement.** *Is the price the class's retail price or the price on the sale line?* From the sale line being refunded — the price actually charged. *Is the delivery fee returned?* It is not part of the refund.
